webvoc_comment: A free text field specifying a range for the number of servings contained in the package.
gdsn_comment: A text description describing the range of servings/portions contained within a trade item. Some items may contain a variance in the number of units or a range, therefore the servings could also vary for the trade item. This attribute should only be used when there is a range of servings. If servings is an exact amount, this should not be used. An example of its use would be a bag of meatballs may contain 18-20 meatballs. If the serving size is 2 meatballs then the numberOfServingsRange would be 9-10 servings or portions.
